content.text: The bug was an off-by-one in `src/sum.js`. The loop used `i <= values.length`, which added `undefined` and returned `NaN`, and changing it to `i < values.length` made `npm test` pass. The two parallel sleeps and `node --help` also ran as requested, with the full help output shown above.
